why_playground.p: We design, roto-mould and fabricate every piece at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. Because the work stays in-house, we check the quality of each part ourselves and can adapt a design to suit your site.

CoreCraft covers multi play systems, swings, slides, see-saws, spring riders and outdoor gym equipment. Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and the NexLev series adds larger, newer play towers.

We work with tested and certified raw materials, galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic in more than 15 colour shades. Each order goes through in-house quality inspection before it leaves the factory.
We manufacture in-house and sell directly or through our dealer network, so you are not paying several middlemen. Tell us your budget and we will suggest equipment that fits it.

Our after-sales team handles spare parts and service on +91 738 530 0921. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty; springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.
We make play equipment for toddlers, for children up to 12 years and for adults. Product pages list the age group, capacity and safe play area so you can plan the space before you order.
Schools, builders, housing societies, municipal bodies, hotels and corporates across India have installed more than 15,000 FunPlay products since we started in 2002.
